titolo: Samaya AI launches Sterling, a 3B finance agent beating Claude Fable 5.1 at 11× lower cost
descr: Samaya AI announced the release of Sterling, a 3 billion‑parameter finance research agent.
paragrafi: Samaya AI announced the release of Sterling, a 3 billion‑parameter finance research agent.
Sterling is built on a post‑trained Nemotron 3.5 Lightning foundation and targets financial question answering.
On the FrontierFinance benchmark it achieved 58.9% accuracy, compared with Claude Fable 5.1’s 55.9% score.
The cost per question for Sterling was $0.61, while Claude Fable 5.1 cost $6.89, an 11‑fold reduction.
Samaya AI highlighted the model’s efficiency for finance‑focused workloads.
perche: For users seeking cost‑effective AI, Sterling offers a cheaper alternative for finance research without sacrificing accuracy. While it is a paid offering, its lower per‑query price may encourage adoption over more expensive proprietary models, especially for organizations with tight budgets.
